about_the_game:
Dice Saga is a RPG/multiplayer party game where four players compete against each other. Build up your character and tear other players down in this colorful and chaotic digital board game!

Four players will have to adventure into dangerous lands and battle ugly monsters to power up their characters. Build up the strongest warrior, or use the tricks at your disposal to ruin the game for other players! It's all in good fun!

Each board has a powerful Boss monster; a risky fight that can grant you great rewards. But beware: other players can turn the fight against your favor or snatch the reward from under your nose, so be quick about it!

There are two ways to play the game: in Blitz, you must build up your character fast, because the game ends with a battle royale, where the champion is declared winner. In Adventure, the last player living, wins, but after every turn and every disgraceful defeat, your age will tick down and, when your life drops to zero, you will roam the board as a ghost. 

Features

  • Up to four players complete in a roguelite against eachother, or against Ai

  • Kill monsters and earn rewards that will help you on your quest, or hinder other players

  • Features a simple, fast combat system that uses dice in an unique way

  • Players are pinned against eachother in regular tournes to see who's build is the strongest

  • Multiple scenarios and game modes!
